title: The multiplicity sequence of monomial ideals
summary: We give a convex-geometric formula for the multiplicity sequence of a monomial ideal in terms of mixed volumes of polytopes constructed from its Newton polyhedron. We also construct a counterexample to a conjecture of Achilles and Manaresi proposing a different volume formula for the multiplicity sequence. Finally, we derive a mixed-volume formula for the mixed multiplicities of arbitrary monomial ideals.
